per_article_summaries: Former F1 driver Jolyon Palmer believes Ferrari's Charles Leclerc would be a good option for Max Verstappen. Verstappen has admitted that he is considering his options at the end of the year. The Dutchman has openly criticised the new regulations, which were introduced in 2026.

Jean Todt was approached by Red Bull founder Dietrich Mateschitz. Todt served as Ferrari team principal from 1993 to 2007. He resigned as CEO in March 2008 but remained on the board of Ferrari until 2009. Todt went on to become FIA president in 2009.

Ferrari is set to introduce substantial upgrades on its SF-26 Formula 1 car at the Miami Grand Prix next week. The cancellation of the Bahrain and Saudi grands prix due to the Iran war has altered not just the calendar but also the update schedule. Ferrari performed a 'filming day' in Monza to evaluate some of its own upgrades.

McLaren Racing CEO Zak Brown says the 'A team and B team' model risks “compromising the integrity of sporting fairness” in Formula 1. Brown was asked about the issue shortly after Red Bull revealed it was hiring sister squad Racing Bulls' deputy technical director Andrea Landi as its head of performance.

Carlos Sainz has revealed that he is encouraged by the progress made in the simulator at Williams. The Spaniard scored the team's only two points at the Chinese Grand Prix. The Miami Grand Prix will resume the season from 1-3 May at Hard Rock Stadium.

Isack Hadjar has signed as Max Verstappen's Red Bull team-mate for 2026. The French-Algerian driver joined Racing Bulls in 2025 for his debut season in F1. He finished the year 12th in the drivers' championship with 51 points.

Oscar Piastri says drivers must focus on “not obvious” data points to maximise their qualifying laps with the new cars. The McLaren driver echoed the overall frustration of wrestling the new cars and rules in qualifying trim. He qualified fifth in Australia and fifth in both the sprint and grand prix in China plus third in Japan.

Former Ferrari team chief Jean Todt reveals how he convinced Michael Schumacher to join the Maranello outfit in 1996. The German driver had already secured back-to-back drivers' championships with Benetton in 1994 and 1995. Todt revealed that he was motivated by a challenge. At that time, Ferrari had not won a drivers' title since 1979.

Formula 1 forced to cancel two rounds shortly after the start of the new season. Our reporters attempt to assess how those races might have played out. Taking into account the opening rounds, the characteristics of the Bahrain and Saudi Arabian circuits, and the developing trends in the pecking order.

McLaren's poster for Miami Grand Prix hints at Sega-inspired livery. Ayrton Senna won the 1993 European Grand Prix sponsored by Sega. Fans have urged McLaren to add drivers Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri to Sonic Racing Crossworlds.
